extracted.name: Easy green gazpacho
extracted.description: Try this green version of gazpacho, brimming with green veg for a fresh as well as satisfying lunch or supper. Enjoy chilled with crusty bread
ingredient_lines: 600ml hot vegetable stock (ensure vegan, if needed)
½ avocado peeled, halved, stoned and roughly chopped
½ green chilli (deseeded if you prefer less heat), roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Put the peas and bread in a large heatproof bowl, pour over the stock and leave for 2 mins before carefully pouring into a jug blender. Season well. Tip in the cucumber, garlic, avocado, vinegar, chilli and most of the spring onions, tomatoes and parsley. Blend until smooth and season to taste. Chill for around 30 mins. Will keep covered and chilled for up to three days.
Spoon the gazpacho into bowls and drizzle over the olive oil. Scatter over the remaining spring onions, tomatoes and parsley, then serve with crusty bread.
